focus_areas: Mechanical integrity of the spark wheel and nozzle assembly
Realism of metallic reflections and specular highlights
Boundary sharpness between the lighter and the concrete surface
Consistency of the black accent band texture
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the spark wheel's geometry. In AI images, serrated wheels often melt into the body. Verify if the teeth are distinct and if the wheel appears capable of rotation. Also, scrutinize the reflection on the chrome body; does it reflect the environment consistently, or are there warped/inconsistent highlights?
image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a metallic disposable lighter lying on its side on a rough concrete surface. The lighter has a silver/chrome finish with black accents near the top. The ignition mechanism (spark wheel and nozzle) is clearly visible in the foreground. The background is blurred (bokeh), showing hints of greenery and a brick structure.

To confirm the specific type of lighter (disposable vs. Zippo-style) and verify class alignment with high confidence.
To check for edge bleeding between the metallic casing and the concrete background, and to verify the continuity of the spark wheel.
